note: Every URL of the single-page kshana.dev (v0.28.0 and earlier) that published material uses, or that the old page itself handed out (share links, embed links, ledger-row links), and where it lands on the multi-page site, as its clean address (/evidence#ledger, /studio/). port_site.py generates web/legacy-redirects.js from the redirects block and refuses to port if a target is missing; web/legacy-urls.test.mjs replays every case. A fragment never reaches the server, so the fragment and query cases are redirected by that script on the home page; the path cases are files that stay where they were. embedTabs maps a result tab the single-page site had and the Studio renamed (fom, the figures-of-merit table, is now part of overview; orbit3d is now orbit); timeseries, stability and sweep kept their names. paths lists addresses that moved (the Studio: /playground/ until 0.29.1, /studio/ since 0.29.2): port_site.py writes a page at each old folder address (playground/index.html) that loads legacy-redirects.js, which forwards there keeping the query and the fragment.
